sentences: Assume that Jun is the head judge.
Jun is not the head judge.
contradictions.explanation: These two statements directly assert and then deny that Jun is the head judge.

sentences: Esme and Dara were on different teams.
Dara and Eli were on different teams.
Esme and Eli were on different teams.
contradictions.explanation: With only three teams, having Esme, Dara, and Eli all pairwise on different teams requires exactly three teams each with one of them, which is possible, but combined with Jun and Yara needing to belong to one of these same three teams, no contradiction arises numerically; however, the mutual pairwise difference claim is inconsistent if any additional constraint forces two of them together, which is not explicitly stated, so this is not a strict contradiction.
